Fed & Policy Watch

FOMC day is the dominant policy catalyst: the official calendar verifies a 2:30 PM ET press conference after the two-day September 15-16 meeting. The statement release time is not separately listed on the verified Fed calendar, so it is not scheduled here.

Forward risk: Treasury bill supply and the 4:15-4:30 PM Fed statistical releases can move funding and duration-sensitive pricing. No NYSE holiday or shortened session is listed for September 16.

Omissions and Watch

BLS omitted: the official September 2026 schedule returned HTTP 403/access denied, so CPI, PPI, employment, and labor releases are not asserted. BEA has no verified September 16 release. NAR is not required for the selected dates.

The verified calendar includes the Census, EIA, TreasuryDirect, and Fed rows above. No additional event is included without a date-specific primary-source date and time. MOVE 83.71 is moderate uncertainty under the stated 80-120 band; NFCI -0.56 indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions.

Trading Strategy Note - ES Futures
Base Case

ES overnight 7673.00 is modestly above the SPY September 15 close of 757.39 context, but FOMC timing and the 10:30 AM EIA report argue for smaller size before the 2:30 PM press conference. With SOFR 3.62%, MOVE 83.71, and 10Y 5.00%, favor defined-risk continuation only while overnight structure holds.

Invalidation

A decisive ES break below the overnight range, a sharp post-FOMC rate or volatility repricing, or a funding-sensitive move with MOVE above 100 invalidates the continuation case. Do not chase the first reaction; reassess after the press conference.
